title: Among posts created in 2010 with more than 10,000 views, calculate the perc
question: Among posts created in 2010 with more than 10,000 views, calculate the percentage of posts whose owners have a reputation greater than 800, and compute the total number of comments made on posts owned by these high-reputation users.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
      AND p.XCL_030 > 10000
),
high_rep_posts AS (
    SELECT qp.post_id
    FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
    INNER JOIN users AS u ON qp.owner_id = u.XCL_052
    WHERE u.XCL_053 > 800
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN hr.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(qp.post_id) AS percentage_high_reputation,
    (SELECT COUNT(c.XCL_005) 
     FROM comments AS c 
     INNER JOIN high_rep_posts AS hr ON c.XCL_006 = hr.post_id) AS total_comments_high_reputation
FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
LEFT JOIN high_rep_posts AS hr ON qp.post_id = hr.post_id

    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS post_id, p.XCL_033 AS owner_id

      AND p.XCL_030 > 10000

)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN hr.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(qp.post_id) AS percentage_high_reputation,

     FROM comments AS c 
     INNER JOIN high_rep_posts AS hr ON c.XCL_006 = hr.post_id) AS total_comments_high_reputation
FROM qualifying_posts AS qp
LEFT JOIN high_rep_posts AS hr ON qp.post_id = hr.post_id

FROM posts AS P
INNER JOIN users AS U ON P.XCL_033 = U.XCL_052
INNER JOIN comments AS C ON C.XCL_006 = P.XCL_026
